affected_subject.reason: Identifies AtomWallet._validateSignature and validateUserOp as the affected component.

trigger_or_action.reason: High-s signature (s' = curve_order - s) submitted to validateUserOp triggers the InvalidSignatureS branch.

direct_effect.reason: InvalidSignatureS branch reverts instead of returning SIG_VALIDATION_FAILED, propagating through handleOps and failing the bundle.

safety_relation_basis.reason: ERC-4337 spec requires returning SIG_VALIDATION_FAILED without reverting; actual behavior reverts, giving expected-vs-actual relation.

summary: Report identifies the affected function, the high-s signature trigger, the revert effect, and the ERC-4337 expected-vs-actual safety relation, sufficient to attempt P/I/V formalization.
